sources.title: VECTOR_DISTANCE (Transact-SQL)
sources.contentRelevance: VECTOR_DISTANCE computes exact scalar float distances and never uses a vector index. Supported metrics are cosine, Euclidean and negative dot product; lower returned distances sort toward closer results.

sources.title: TOP (Transact-SQL)
sources.contentRelevance: TOP without a query-level ORDER BY selects an undefined subset. The order controlling a ranked function or an outer UNION result does not by itself bind an inner TOP candidate pool.

sources.contentRelevance: RANK computes positions using an OVER ordering and returns bigint; query-level ordering separately determines returned row order. Full-text relevance values must be converted to positions for RRF.

sources.title: / (Division) (Transact-SQL)
sources.contentRelevance: T-SQL integer division truncates the fractional part; result type follows operand precedence. An RRF numerator must participate in noninteger division before evaluation, not be cast after an integer quotient has already become zero.
